units.source_text: 临睡之前，俊吉从檐廊上的一扇防雨门里走到了狭小的庭院中。

en.t: Before going to bed, Shunkichi stepped out through one of the rain shutters on the veranda into the small garden.

units.source_text: 接着，他招呼了一句：“今晚的月亮很不错，出来一起看啊。”

en.t: Then he called out, "The moon is lovely tonight; come out and look at it with me."
It was not clear whom he was calling to.

units.source_text: 信子一个人走在俊吉身后，在檐廊处换上了庭院木屐。

en.t: Nobuko walked alone behind Shunkichi and changed into garden clogs at the veranda.

units.source_text: 信子光着脚，没穿布袜，感到有些许清冷。

en.t: Nobuko was barefoot, without tabi socks, and felt a slight chill.
